summary: Weatherford International plc filed an 8-K reporting a prospectus supplement to its June 13, 2025 Form S-3ASR shelf (No. 333-288045) covering the resale of up to 357,159 ordinary shares by a selling shareholder, with an Irish-law opinion (Exhibit 5.1) filed in support. The shares were issued as merger consideration in the previously reported closing of the NCS Multistage Holdings acquisition. This is a routine post-closing resale registration/overhang mechanics filing, not a new special situation; no price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. Watch registration overhang and any selling-shareholder dispositions.
